conventions.clockwise: Viewed from outside the face, looking toward cube center
conventions.faceMatrixOrder: Rows top-to-bottom and columns left-to-right when each face is viewed from outside. U top row is toward B; D top row is toward F.
conventions.lowercaseLegacy: r/l/u/d/f/b denote inner second layer in this source; exported move list uses unambiguous 2R etc.
conventions.wideMoves: Rw is two layers; 3Rw is three layers; 2R is ONLY inner second layer.
conventions.rotations: x like R, y like U, z like F, all layers selected
conventions.frameTiming: Frame i is BEFORE moves[i]; final frame is AFTER the complete sequence.
conventions.symbolMeaning: Sticker color symbols remain their HOME face identities after moves, not their current face positions.
conventions.rightHandedPalette: U yellow, D white, F green, R orange, L red, B blue; fixed stickers never change color when the camera moves.
conventions.captionRule: Default captions describe face-relative clockwise direction, never fixed screen up/left. Original author notes such as Lên remain only in sourceCaption.
